posts.author: Bnje
posts.body: I am undertaking 2 projects, One Fantasy game and one Apocalypse game as my primary objectives in creating a game. I have side projects planned too that I don't prioritise. Most of these projects I feel don't benefit from the whole "Anime / Chibi" style of RPGmaker VX Ace. Without paid steam DLC's, what can be done about not having Anime Characters in the "Character Creation" menu?

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
If you want more realistic assets, I know a few sets that you'd probably love. Both for a fantasy setting and an apocalyptic setting. But those are not free. In fact, they are not cheap at all. And I actually don't want you to use them, because the more users use those graphics, the less exclusive they become for me.
The sets I talk about are Medieval for fantasy worlds and 2.5D for a war-destroyed world, buth sets are absolutely stunning and enormous. But, like I said, you'd be down a couple bucks... (More like a couple hundred, if you want to buy everything.)
I think finding a very complete alternative to RTP for free, is going to be very, very hard. Most freely available stuff is made to fit in with RTP, not to replace them.
Edit: I notice this is for VX Ace. The sets are made for a 48x48 grid, which does not work with VX Ace out of the box, but it can work with the right scripts. It makes things a lot more complicated though. I wouldn't advice it.

posts.author: kirbwarrior
posts.body: Is it specifically VX Ace or RPG Maker in general? If you own older RMs, you can use their RTPs if they seem less "manga-y". Importantly, both XP and 2k(3) use less chibi sprites.
